newsitem.title: FINLAND: Pohjola says transfer of non-life delayed.
newsitem.headline: Pohjola says transfer of non-life delayed.

text.p: Finnish insurance group Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola said on Wednesday the planned transfer of Pohjola's non-life insurance portfolio FSLIX.O to a new company to be established will be delayed.

"The license for Vahinko-Pohjola and the transfer of the insurance portfolio from Pohjola will be postponed beyond the originally targeted rapid schedule as the issue is still being reviewed by the authorities," Pohjola said in a statement.
According to the original schedule, Pohjola's insurance portfolio had been due to be transferred by July 1.
Otherwise Pohjola's restructuring was on track, it said.
Last week Pohjola announced it had had to revise its restructuring plan and intended to remain as an insurance company as the authorities had not approved its planned switch into a holding company.

Pohjola in January announced plans to become a holding company with two main subsidiaries; the non-life insurance business and the life-insurance business, which is currently managed by its associated company Suomi.
